design_brief_zh: 主卖点是箱体侧面四个挂钩，购买理由是机场拉行李时可悬挂多个袋子，减少手提负担并方便取放；事实证据仅使用侧面四个挂钩、顶部一个金属挂钩及可挂多个袋子，不延伸到承重、稳固或免手提等未提供规格。PC画布1464×600：左侧产品区[x,y,w,h]=[0.05,0.08,0.46,0.84]，以行李箱3/4侧前方角度为主，清楚露出四个侧面挂钩和顶部金属挂钩；机场通道或候机区中，一位商务旅行者自然拉行李箱，多个不同尺寸的袋子挂在侧面挂钩上，但不遮挡箱体结构。右侧文案区[x,y,w,h]=[0.57,0.1,0.38,0.8]，PC阅读顺序为标题→支持说明→“侧面四个挂钩”→“顶部一个金属挂钩”，德语版预留约20%横向扩展空间。移动端1200×900：上方场景/产品区[x,y,w,h]=[0.08,0.05,0.84,0.53]，下方文案区[x,y,w,h]=[0.05,0.64,0.9,0.31]，按相同标题、说明、两条证据顺序纵向阅读；确保挂钩在移动裁切中仍可辨识。产品需保持上传实物的聚碳酸酯/ABS硬壳、铝合金框架、竖条纹表面和实际颜色，不添加未提供的结构。采用欧洲现代旅行摄影、低饱和中性色与机场自然光，柔和侧光突出挂钩轮廓和箱体纹理，避免过度反光。字体使用Arial、Helvetica或Amazon Ember风格无衬线，标题较大加粗，说明与细节短句分层，数字和“四个/一个”清晰易读。
compliance_note_zh: 仅展示已提供的挂钩数量与用途，不宣称承重、耐用性、稳固性或免手提效果；袋子数量与摆放应保持适度，不能遮挡挂钩。不得添加竞品商标、认证、评分、促销信息或绝对化表述，产品结构和颜色须与实物一致。
image_prompt_en: Create a premium European modern airport travel photograph for a YWJ hard-shell suitcase, matching the supplied product appearance exactly: vertical-striped polycarbonate/ABS shell, aluminium frame, and the selected real color. Show one suitcase from a clear three-quarter side angle in an airport corridor or terminal, with four visible side hooks holding several modest travel bags and one visible metal hook on top holding one bag; keep every hook and its attachment point unobstructed. A traveler is naturally pulling the suitcase, creating a practical airport-use story without making the bags look overloaded. Use low-saturation neutral tones, natural window light, soft directional highlights on the hooks and shell texture, realistic proportions, and a clean premium composition. For desktop, place the suitcase and airport scene in the left 46% and leave the right 38% as calm, uncluttered negative space for copy. For mobile, compose the scene in the upper 53% with the hooks readable and leave the lower 31% visually quiet for copy. Preserve the specified product structure; do not add features or alter hook locations. No rendered text, letters, logos, labels, badges, icons, watermarks, or promotional graphics in the image.
